notes.author: pete
notes.text: Met with Derek and Kayla after the service. Derek's hours were cut again, and they are behind on bills. Prayed together. {@ted} will walk them through the benevolence process.
notes.testPurpose: A pastoral note with a mention and a reply.

replies.author: ted
replies.text: Talked with them today. The team is covering the electric bill and next month's groceries.

notes.author: pete
notes.text: Session two with Derek on stress and work uncertainty. He is sleeping better and applying for steadier jobs. Next meeting in two weeks.
notes.testPurpose: A Counseling note, seen only by pastoral staff.

notes.author: pete
notes.text: Closed out counseling with Derek after five sessions. He has steady work again and a plan for the family budget. Will check in once in three months.
